names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 februarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Φεβρουαρίου, «Οσία Άννα η Πριγκίπισσα», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Sfânta Ana a adormit întru Domnul la 10 februarie 1050.» The same page dates her marriage to Yaroslav at Novgorod to the summer of 1016 and gives no year of birth.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 februarie — «Sfânta Cuvioasă Ana din Novgorod»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Οσία Άννα η Πριγκίπισσα»

attestations.note: The page closes with a second day: «Η Εκκλησία τιμά την μνήμη της και στις 4 Οκτωβρίου» — the Church honours her memory also on 4 October. One attestation row is one feast, so the row records the day read and the second day stands here as a note. The page also warns that she is often confused with the mother of Vladimir, enlightener of the Russians, because she had a son of the same name.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
